rule: Christmas or Advent must drive the story or be a documented household tradition. Balance family reunions, holiday romance, Christmas fantasy and comedy. A December premiere without a holiday premise stays out.

title: Until Sunrise
rule: The principal action spans one night. Use the overnight pursuit, party, crime or first-date structure of a reference. Night photography alone is insufficient.

title: One Last Movie Before New Year
rule: New Year's Eve, midnight or the turn of the year changes the story or provides its decisive scene. Alternate celebration, romance and countdown thrillers. A general late-December release is too broad.
